_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Giocatô Serpe in sce 'n {width}×{height} griglia.
Te controli a serpe {player_id}. Mövi validi: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ò 'w'/'s'/'a'/'d').
Obietivo: sopravvîve o êse a serpe ciù longa e ottegni o punteggio ciù alto (limite de {max_turns} torni).

game_action.invalid_death: O serpente {player_id} o l'é mòrto pe-a moæ invalida.

outcome.survived_win: O zugatô {player_id} o l'é rescivæu; tutti i atri en mòrti.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Tutti i serpenti en mòrti à l'instante.
outcome.outlived: O xugador o l'à sopravvisciûo a tùtti i âtri.
outcome.turn_limit: O limite de rotaçion o l'é stæto raggiunto: a ciù bella scortua vinse in tie-break.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Grùppi de clasificaçión finâle (da-o pèzo a-o mêgio): {groups}
